title: Resolve separation-of-concerns / dependency-direction debt
description:
**Dimension: separation-of-concerns · 4 findings (2 medium, 2 low)** — see report §separation-of-concerns.

- (med) `gf2-core/src/bitvec.rs:1466` — four `polar_transform*` methods implement the Arikan (2009) coding-theory kernel on the lowest-level primitive type. Move to `gf2-coding` as free functions / extension trait, OR rename neutrally (e.g. `hadamard_butterfly`) if a generic GF(2) butterfly genuinely belongs in core.
- (med) `gf2-kernels-hip/Cargo.toml:24` — dev-deps on `gf2-algebra` AND `gf2-coding`, which depend on `gf2-kernels-hip` in production (two reversed test-layer edges). Relocate the cross-check/QAM tests to the crates where the reference types live.
- (low) `gf2-kernels-simd/Cargo.toml:34` — dev-dep on `gf2-algebra` inverts layer order; move Packed5/Packed7 cross-check proptests into `gf2-algebra`'s own suite.
- (low) `gf2-core/src/sparse.rs:558` — `deterministic_ldpc_like_fixture` embeds "ldpc" in a core `#[doc(hidden)]` export; rename to `deterministic_sparse_fixture`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `polar_transform*` placement resolved (moved to gf2-coding or renamed neutrally in core) with a recorded rationale.
- [hard] The two reversed dev-dep edges (hip→algebra/coding, simd→algebra) removed by relocating the affected tests, OR explicitly justified in this issue if relocation is infeasible.
- [hard] `deterministic_ldpc_like_fixture` renamed (all call sites updated).
- [hard] `cargo nextest --profile ci`, clippy, fmt pass; dependency graph free of the cited reversed edges.
